text:
Jordan_CSM: Quick check — proposing a low-risk perf pilot for NebulaPay: int8 quantized model + staged routing to regional warm pool. Goal: drop p50 from ~220ms to ~170ms and shave ~20% token cost. Renewal Q3, could be a value win. Thoughts?
Mia_CS: Love the idea. Customer is sensitive to small quality diffs — they called out hallucination risk. Need an explicit rollback and output-sampling plan.
Sam_SE: Agree on rollback. Technical ask: can we run a 10% canary with `fallback: model:v1` and capture a blind eval on a 500-sample prompt set? Also want sequence length distribution and p95/p99 before we start.
Lee_RE: Pushed quick stats to the thread: median seq ~120, 75th ~220, p95 spikes coincide with daily batch around 14:00 UTC. Baseline p50=218ms, p95=680ms. I'll paste a small slice:```json
{"hour":"14","reqs":3420,"p50":310,"p95":720}```
Mia_CS: Perfect. I'll tell the customer we plan a short pilot window and will share sampled outputs + rollback within 1h if quality drops. They'll want to see the exact prompts sampled.
Sam_SE: Canary config (preflight):
```yaml
traffic_split: 0.10
model_variant: nebula-v2-int8
fallback: nebula-v2-fp16
max_latency_slo_s: 0.45
collect_samples: true
```
Sam_SE: Also will run a synthetic run for the heavy-hour distribution to validate p95 impact. ETA ~60m.
ops_bot: Deploy bot: initiating canary for nebula-v2-int8 -> 10% traffic at 3112223380. Watch `canary/3112223334` dashboard.
ops_bot: Canary status: 2h running, error rate unchanged, p50 down 18%, p95 down 12%. No regression alerts.
Sam_SE: Nice. Saving sample outputs to `/tmp/nebula_canary_samples_3112223334.json` and pushing to shared drive.
Mia_CS: I'll update renewal deck with expected cost savings and include sample outputs + short quality summary. Tagging finance offline for exact $ savings calc. :thumbsup:
Jordan_CSM: Thanks team — if ops_bot stays green for 24h we'll propose this as a standard optimization in the renewal play. Leaving notes for next steps and customer comms.
__notes: This thread records a short operational coordination between CS and Eng for a proactive canary: quantization + routing pilot for a renewal-risk account. Messages are concise and include config snippets, bot deploy updates, and next steps.
